newsitem.title: GERMANY: Porsche mulls assembly in Asia - report.
newsitem.headline: Porsche mulls assembly in Asia - report.

text.p: German luxury car maker Dr.-Ing. h.c.F. Porsche AG is close to concluding talks about assembling cars in Indonesia with a local partner, the weekly magazine Der Spiegel reported on Saturday.

Porsche has been negotiating with Indomobil, Indonesia's second-largest car maker, to have it assemble Porsche cars at a plant some 100 km of Jakarta, Spiegel said in a report made available before publication on Monday.
Porsche was not immediately available for comment.
The report said Porsche would deliver German-manufactured components for its 911 model to be assembled in Indonesia in order to circumvent high tariffs on European car imports.
Indomobil, which has nearly completed building the assembly facility, also hoped to strike similar deals with German car makers Volkswagen and Audi.
